title: THE SIREN SAYS LOCKED ON
why: His words of 2026-10-15: there is a siren noise he hears sometimes and does not know what it means. It is the lock-on siren, which starts when a machine has had its eyes on you for over half a second. It now says what it is: a LOCKED ON alert, with a short line under it, the moment the siren starts, and it lands in the feed too. It says it once per lock-on, not over and over while the siren plays, and again for a fresh lock-on after the usual five second cool-off. The extraction low alarm already comes with the EXTRACTION CALLED alert.
now: The lock-on siren now flashes LOCKED ON so you know what it means.

edits.replacement: if(!n){ MSIREN.said=0; if(MSIREN.v||MSIREN.on) machSirenOff(); return true; }
